title: Long Time Behaviour of the Two-Component Becker-Döring System
summary: The classical Becker-Döring equations describe the formation of clusters by aggregation and fragmentation of monomers. If the total amount of mass is supercritical, larger and larger clusters are formed, leading to an asymptotic loss of mass in the long time limit. The two-component Becker-Döring system arises when clusters are built from two types of monomers. Here, we study the natural extension of the one-component system, where no energy or entropy is leaving or entering the system - the so called detailed balance assumption.
